CliExecAfterHelp:
Examples:
  dse exec "explain this function"
  dse exec --auto "fix the failing tests"
  dse exec --auto --output-format stream-json "fix and verify"

Plain `dse exec` returns one model response.
`--auto` enables the non-interactive tool agent with Agent decides. Host-classified
critical calls still require approval and fail closed in headless execution.
Only the explicit process-level `--yolo` override selects Full access.
CliArgStdio: Run the same newline-delimited canonical Run API over standard input/output

CliArgInsecureNoAuth: Allow unauthenticated HTTP only on a loopback address
CliArgCorsOrigin: Allowed browser origin; may be repeated
CliArgMaxBodyBytes: Maximum HTTP request-body size in bytes
CliArgTransportMaxRetries: Maximum transport retries for each DeepSeek request
CliAppServerAfterHelp:
Transports:
  dse app-server          Start the HTTP/SSE Run API on 127.0.0.1:7878
  dse app-server --stdio  Start the canonical newline Run API over stdio

HTTP requires --auth-token or DSE_APP_SERVER_TOKEN by default. Unauthenticated
HTTP is allowed only when the user explicitly chooses --insecure-no-auth on a
loopback address.
